stem: One way Angie tries to encourage Pete is by —

options.label: A
options.text: promising him that he will find great fame on the Internet

options.label: B
options.text: explaining to him that she was too busy taping the football game to see his performance

options.label: C
options.text: telling him that he will be on a video with others who also sang the national anthem at football games

options.label: D
options.text: reminding him that singing the national anthem is something most people are not brave enough to do
